name: Rork
tagline: Build native mobile apps by chatting with AI.
description: Rork turns plain-language prompts into working iOS and Android apps. Its Pro tier generates React Native + Expo projects you can preview live and ship to the App Store and Google Play, while Rork Max builds native SwiftUI apps compiled with Xcode. It focuses on mobile as the target surface rather than web pages, and produces real native apps instead of web wrappers.
insight: Launched February 2025 via a single tweet, then raised a $15M seed led by Left Lane Capital with a16z Speedrun participating.

modelSupport.notes: Rork Max is powered by Anthropic's Claude (Claude Code / Claude Opus).

edge: Mobile-first vibe coding that ships real native iOS/Android apps to the stores, where most prompt-to-app tools output web pages or wrappers.
pros: Ships to App Store and Google Play

references.title: Rork Raises $15 Million for AI Mobile App Creation
